worldModelStatus() 补 exists 字段：loaded 是懒加载的运行时状态（game-session.ts:591「懒加载：首次注入时才加载世界模型」），开跑前查它必然是 false，拿它当事前门禁是先有鸡还是先有蛋——上一版只报 loaded，等于没给出「需要时能不能加载成功」这个真正想问的问题的答案。加 exists（existsSync，廉价，不触发加载），loaded 保留作事后观测（开跑几回合、建过会话后应翻成 true）。头注释写明两个字段的分工：exists:true 且 loaded:false 是完全正常的状态，不是 bug。核实过程中发现本机 ../世界模型/ 目录本身是空的，用测试自建的合成小夹具走真实 HTTP 验证。新增 3 条测试（worldModelStatus 测试文件从 4 条扩到 7 条）：exists 随磁盘文件真实存在与否变化、exists:false 时 loaded 必然也是 false、exists:true 但 loaded:false 的状态被显式钉住（这正是本次的坑，不钉住下次还会有人拿 loaded 当门禁）。变异检验：硬编码 exists:true，3 条精确变红，Copy-Item 还原后回归 7/7。手动服务器级验证：WORLD_MODEL_PATH 分别指向不存在路径与合成小夹具，两次真实起 bun run src/api/server.ts 打 GET /api/config，分别报 exists:false 与 exists:true（后者同时 loaded:false，因为没建会话触发懒加载，进一步印证 exists 与 loaded 互不干扰）

实跑证据（会话 bhklwkwu，34 回合）暴露的三个耦合问题，同一轮修完。定位结论（先查后改）：intent 解析本身是对的（parseIntent 探针实测「去特里坎家」→action:move、target:特里坎家），根因全在 handleIntent 与 act() 的控制流，没有动 intent 解析范围。① handleIntent 的 case "move"/"look" 在模块模式下无视 tryResolveModuleScene() 的返回值、一律 return false——那句 docstring 早就写着「返回值在两个调用点都被丢掉」，写了没改，移动成功了也被报成没处理，继续往下走到战斗检测；两处改成如实转发返回值。② act() 里 `this.combatActive || 攻击词` 的判断把「战斗还没结束」和「这句话是攻击」混成一件事，非攻击输入（移动解析失败、纯叙述、聊天）只要没被 handleIntent 接住就被判成打人；改成只看输入本身是否像攻击，combatActive 不再单独构成理由——但 combatActive 本身不在这里被清掉，不产生攻击判定不等于战斗结束，落点仍是 LLM 叙事分支。③ aliveEnemies()（战斗旗/还手/退出战斗/自由行动战斗判定四处共用）原先不按场景过滤，加 `(scene_id ?? position) === 当前场景` 判断（pos==="unknown" 时不过滤，避免大量约定俗成用占位场景名、从未真正注册场景的测试夹具整批消失）；同时把 act() 里的自由行动战斗块与 handleAttack() 各自的内联敌人过滤都换成复用 aliveEnemies()，消灭三处重复实现。加 combat-escape-and-scene-scope.test.ts（9 条，三个症状各三条：正确行为/目标行为错误的对照/文本相似但合法不误报）。变异检验：三处分别还原成 bug 版本，对应测试精确变红（第一次测试设计漏了两个盲区又补上——症状 2/3 的场景里有真实模组 NPC，泛指攻击的伤害可能落在未被断言追踪的 NPC 身上让 mutation 白测，改用「压根没有攻击判定发生」和挑一个模组未安排 NPC 的场景来消除歧义），Copy-Item 还原后回归 9/9。顺带发现并保留：aliveEnemies() 的 scene_id/position 双轨兜底与 pos==="unknown" 豁免都是运行中发现的真实测试夹具兼容性问题，不是猜的

线索按玩家输入匹配。实跑：「侦查卫生间」返回休息区的手枪线索，「侦查餐厅」返回卫生间的毒品线索——不是偏移一位，是玩家输入从未被读取。handleSkillCheck 只取 getUndiscoveredSceneClues(pos,playerId).find(hasClueType) 的第一条，intent.target/input 一眼都不看。数据其实都在：BARN_OF_PREMIER 32/32 条线索的 findMethods[].description 里就是位置/动作提示，但 bridgeBarnOfPremierClues 桥接时整个丢了，只取 skillName 映射技能、拿 revelation 填四档文本。① ClueDef 加 matchTexts/displayName/importance 三个可选字段（importance 只存不消费，留给后续新手辅助）；bridgeBarnOfPremierClues 把 [clue.name, ...findMethods.map(f=>f.description)] 存进 matchTexts。② 新增 src/investigation/clue-match.ts：matchSceneClues() 按 / 、，,：:+ 切词（32 条里只有 5 条带 /，其余 27 条是自由文本，不能只切 /），复用 move-util.ts 的 isRejectedMention/uniqueAbbrevs（hasMoveIntent 是移动专用动词，换成新写的 hasSearchIntent 认「侦查/检查/搜索」这类调查动词；matchKeys/chooseConnection 类型绑死 SceneConnection，另写轻量版）。命中唯一→解析；命中多条→报 ask 选项，不擅自选；一条不中→deny（如实说「这里没什么特别的」，不是给下一条——比拒绝更糟的正是「不看输入给下一条」这类病）；没给提示（去掉动词后不剩什么）→ fallback 回落旧行为，这是「没说要找什么」不是「说了没对上」，两回事。handleSkillCheck 加 input 参数接 resolveSceneClueMatch() 的判定。③ 判据：照 phrasing.ts 的形状做 src/diagnostics/clue-phrasing.ts（PhraseCase 三类正例/反例/歧义，failKind 四类 no-key/rival-only/ambiguous/forced-hit），配 scripts/diag/diag-clue-phrasing.ts 拿 BARN_OF_PREMIER 真实数据（10 个多线索场景×124 条用例）跑分：目标命中率 106/124=85.5%、反例 25/25=100%、歧义「不擅自选一个」9/10=90%，三类失败都有真实非零样本（不是全 0 的假完美）。判据本身在实跑中被抓到一次假红并修正：ambiguous 类判据原先要求 ambiguousIds.length>=2 才算过，但「没给任何位置提示」（裸「侦查」）合法的诚实结果是「压根没命中」，不是「必须报出两个候选」——把判据错拿去考匹配器没有的职责，是判据自己的设计错误，改成只要求 chosenClueId===null。新增测试：clue-match.test.ts（8 条，matchSceneClues/hasSearchIntent 单测）、scene-clue-input-match.test.ts（6 条，GameSession 端到端，实跑症状原句复现+对照+歧义构造）、diag-clue-phrasing.test.ts（28 条，判据校准+端到端真实数据+「退回取第一条」变异检验）。变异检验（生产代码）：还原成「取候选第一条」的旧行为，2/6 端到端测试精确变红（另两条巧合仍对，符合预期）；clue-match.ts 内部拆两处分别验证 isRejectedMention 在完整键/简称两条路径各自的贡献。Copy-Item 还原后回归全绿

两处读取层判据修复，不改被扫描代码/数据本身。① preflight 第 8 项（返回值被丢掉）的 BOOL_IMPL 正则 `\([^()]*\)` 不允许参数列表嵌套括号，而本仓处理器签名普遍带回调类型参数（`msg: (s: string) => number`），单层正则直接匹配失败——实测 game-session.ts 28 个真正返回 boolean 的方法，原判据只认得出 3 个（93% 漏判），全仓 73/93（漏 26）。判据看不见自己的立案原型案例 setActiveScene（source-scan.ts 头注释拿它当理由）。boolReturningNames() 改用从 `): boolean {` 反向做括号配平扫描，不设嵌套深度上限（不是「允许一层嵌套」这种换个数字的补丁，本仓已经因「看着够用」的单层假设漏了 93%）。实测放宽后全仓新增报告 0 条（工作树里唯一真实例 tryResolveModuleScene 在此前轮次已手工修掉），核实规模不会失控。任务给的「26 个漏网名单」核实后有 2 处错误：setActiveScene 定义在 world-state-manager.ts 不在 game-session.ts（只是调用点在那），getPlayerInventory 返回 string[] 根本不是 boolean——这两条据实剔除，不放进断言硬凑数字。加 6 条测试（嵌套/两层嵌套/接口签名不算实现/if-while 不误认/game-session.ts 端到端 ≥28 个且含验证过的 24 个/setActiveScene 在它真正定义的文件里能被认出）。变异检验：把 `case "rest": return this.handleRest(...)` 改成裸调用丢返回值，preflight 第 8 项精确报出该行；Copy-Item 还原后回归 0 findings。② clue-match.ts：diag-clue-phrasing.ts 判据自己跑出的真实发现——「艾德里安的卧室」场景裸「侦查」精确命中 clue_bedroom_diary，只因为它唯一的 findMethods 描述恰好写的是「侦查或挪开床头柜」，玩家等于什么都没说，引擎却擅自挑了一个。matchSceneClues() 加通用判据（不是给「侦查」开特例）：把 said 里所有调查类动词（复用既有 SEARCH_VERB 动词表，不新开黑名单）都抠掉，剩下内容不足 2 字就判定「无位置信号」，报 ambiguous=全部候选而不精确命中——同一份动词表已经在给 hasSearchIntent 用，这里只是换个角度复用，不是新造特例。重跑 diag-clue-phrasing.ts：歧义类「不擅自选一个」9/10→10/10（达标），other 分类归零；正例命中率 106/124→98/124（下降，非上升，不违反「不得因这条上升」的验收线）——核实后确认是好事：「掐前2/3字」缩写测试里有 8 条恰好等于裸动词本身（如「检查」「搜查」「观察」），此前因为在局部候选组里恰好唯一而被误判成精确命中，现在被同一条通用判据正确拦下，这与本轮要修的是同一类问题，只是由不同测试用例触发；原有 18 条真实 ambiguous 失败样本逐条核对仍然失败（6 条因判据内部提前返回、trace.matched 未populate而被 classifyClueFailure 重新分类到 no-key，但没有一条从失败变成通过）。补 diag-clue-phrasing.md 报告文件。新增测试：clue-match.test.ts 追加「无位置信号的裸动词」describe 块（10 条，覆盖 7 个不同动词证明通用性、ambiguous 列出全部候选、动词+真实内容不受影响、多动词堆叠仍判无信号）。变异检验：注释掉判据分支，3 条精确变红（含复刻真实案例的那一条），另 7 条按词表巧合仍过（该 7 词在测试用的两候选夹具里本就不会碰撞，符合预期不代表判据没生效）；Copy-Item 还原后回归 18/18

上一轮给 matchSceneClues 加的裸动词早退路径暴露出判据层三个问题，同一轮修完，都在判据层，不改匹配器行为。① classifyClueFailure() 靠 matched.length===0 猜 no-key，而早退路径在填充 matched 之前就返回，26 条失败里 14 条被误诊成「切词方式太窄缺同义词」（no-key），实际是「引擎正确拒绝猜测」（no-signal）——两者修法相反，照错误处方去加同义词等于推翻上一轮的修复。加 ClueMatchTrace.noSignal 结构化标记（早退时置位），classifyClueFailure 先读这个标记再判，不再猜。CluePhraseFailKind 从四类扩到五类，no-signal 明确标注「不需要修，用例该改标成 ambiguous」。② clue-match.ts 的 contentOnly.length<2 阈值原先隐式，补注释说明为什么是 2（不是 1：单字满大街都是，和 splitKeys 已有的 minLen 约定对齐；不是 3：会误伤「床底」这类真实存在的 2 字位置名词，此前实测踩过这个坑），钉 4 条边界测试（剩 0/1 字→无信号，剩 2 字→参与匹配，纯 1 字输入无动词前缀同样无信号）。③ diag-clue-phrasing.ts 的「掐前2/3字」正例用例直接切原始描述前缀，很多描述以调查动词开头（「搜查二层杂物室」），切出来的是裸动词本身，按设计注定报歧义，正例命中率被一批打不赢的用例永久压着。抽出 stripSearchVerbs()（从 clue-match.ts 导出，matchSceneClues 内部也改用它，避免两处各自维护一份动词表），缩写用例改成「先剥动词、再切内容部分的前缀」——不是重新分类失败用例，是从源头不生成会撞见动词的缩写。重跑 diag-clue-phrasing.ts：no-signal 分类归零（原 14 条大部分不再生成，其余归入正确的 no-signal 桶，报告里因为该桶「不需要修」不计入需要关注的失败）；原 18 条真实 ambiguous 失败逐条核对仍然失败（「仔细」「艾德」「搜查二层杂物室」「成功」「老旧」等，个别因内容切法变化换了具体命中的字符但性质不变），一条未被放松；歧义类 10/10 保持；正例命中率 98/124→104/120，上升但可解释——分母减少 4（个别候选内容不足 4 字不再生成缩写用例）、分子增加，全部来自「用例改对了」（不再包含无解的裸动词缩写），matchSceneClues 本身的匹配逻辑字节级未改动（只多了 trace.noSignal 记录与 stripSearchVerbs 提取复用，不影响判定结果，clue-match.test.ts 既有测试全绿印证）。新增/改动测试：diag-clue-phrasing.test.ts 补 5 条 classifyClueFailure 用例（no-signal 结构化判定 + 3 组干扰：matched 为空但未置位仍是 no-key、字段缺失回落 no-key、noSignal 为真时无视 matched 内容）+ 1 条判据变异检验（模拟删掉早退逻辑，走真实 addCluePhraseResult 管线确认分类落在 other 而非 no-signal——ambiguous 类失败由该函数硬编码为 other，不会调用 classifyClueFailure，故意验证的是报告实际会出现的分类）；clue-match.test.ts 补 4 条阈值边界测试。变异检验（生产代码，双重验证）：① classifyClueFailure 去掉 noSignal 判断，2 条新测试精确变红；② matchSceneClues 关闭早退分支（if(false&&...)），clue-match.test.ts 6 条直接变红，重跑 diag-clue-phrasing.ts 观察到歧义类 10/10→9/10、报告 failKinds 表出现「其它:1」而非「no-signal」，与单测结论一致。两处 Copy-Item 还原后回归全绿，重新生成的报告确认 10/10 与 104/120

建一个 PC 有三个入口三种做法（构造函数p1/"创建角色"重建p1/"创建队友"建p2+），八项该做的事（sanityEngines.set/SAN取角色POW/world.registerPlayer/persistSanity/session.join/characters.set/world.upsertEntity/careerStore快照）没有一条路径全做齐，八项里只有characters.set三处都做。不只是"多人还没做"：单人现在就有活bug——"创建角色"一处SAN相关代码都没有，新角色沿用构造时那个角色的SAN引擎，maxSAN仍是旧角色的POW推出来的；"创建队友"缺upsertEntity，构造函数自己的注释记过这个后果（"开局的KP伤害因为找不到实体而失败……两相抵消，谁都看不出来"）对p2+一直活着。加PartyMember类型（{pcId,sheet,san,control,difficulty?}，difficulty保留字段本轮不消费）与party:Map<string,PartyMember>第三张索引——不取代characters/sanityEngines两张Map，sheet/san与它们里的对象是同一份引用，party只补它们不管的东西（control）。新增createPartyMember()单一入口，三处调用点（构造函数/handleCreateCharacter/"创建队友"）全部改为调用它，删掉各自重复的四到八行手写版本。边界情形："创建角色"语义定为"重建当前活跃PC"（this.activePlayerId，不是硬编码p1）——已存在的pcId整体重建（新SanityEngine换旧的，不是合并更新）；重名PC不构成冲突，因为session.join的key是pcId（自动生成，如"p2""p3"）不是角色名，两个角色同名不会撞异常；本轮不提供删除PC命令（PlayerSession.leave会销毁messageHistory，没有任何现有命令触发删除，留给下一轮）。人数：硬上限10人拒绝（PARTY_HARD_LIMIT，新pcId且party已满10人时拒绝，重建已存在pcId不受影响）；模组推荐人数解析自meta.playerCount（"2~3"这类字符串，parsePlayerCountRange支持波浪号/连字符/中文"至到"/单数字，解析不出来返回null不强猜），超出推荐人数警告后放行，不实现任何按人数缩放的规则（仓库里没有这类规则，属于另一轮）；只对BARN_OF_PREMIER生效（registeredModules装的是MythosModule类型，BARN_OF_PREMIER是ModuleData类型，两套类型系统没有整体打通，只在mod.id==="premiers_barn"时复用它的meta.playerCount，不是给所有模组都接了推荐人数）。control字段从CompanionState原样搬（"auto"|`player:${string}`），本轮只建字段与读写口不接调度，p1默认"auto"，"创建队友"的新成员默认"auto"（同CompanionState既有默认值），没有任何消费方读它——留给L2/L3的AI 缺陷：无archetype建会话后直接创建队友会顶掉玩家自己的p1槽位。机制——构造函数不带archetype时走空壳分支（:372-388），建sanityEngines["p1"]/world.registerPlayer("p1")/session.join("p1")但不调createPartyMember，所以this.party是空的；"创建队友"算pid用this.party.size+1，party.size为0→pid="p1"，队友的卡直接覆盖空壳的SAN引擎/characters/世界实体，session.get("p1")已存在走switchActive分支，播报却说"加入了队伍"——本仓反复修的"报告了一件没发生的事"。根因是pid分配依赖了一个已知会短暂失同步的计数（party不是唯一持有pcId的地方）。改法：新增私有nextFreePcId()，取一个当前未被占用的id，占用判定取**所有**四类持有者的并集——this.party/sanityEngines/session.getAllNames()/world.getPlayerIds()。给出选择理由：场bug的本质就是各持有者会短暂失同步，取并集是与这个失败模式同构的防御（correct by construction），代价只是O(成员数)扫表且上限PARTY_HARD_LIMIT=10；不只用最完整的world.getPlayerIds()一份，因为本次缺陷恰好因为依赖单一/失同步的信息源而引入。分配策略从1往上找第一个空位（不是单调递增不复用）：pcId语义是"固定归属"，空壳槽位p1、被重建的同id PC都不该被后建的人抢走；本轮无删除入口所以PlayerSession.leave()（销毁messageHistory，player-session.ts:73-79）不会触发，复用不会真发生旧历史串到新PC上，即便将来加删除，leave连id一起删这里仍正确。**不改空壳分支**（不让它调createPartyMember）：没有角色卡就得塞占位数据，会把"八项齐全"变成"七项加一个假的"，保留原注释。干扰侧确认：session按pcId做key（空壳join("p1",...)首参即key、createPartyMember.join(pcId,...)），getAllNames()返回的正是pcId，一致。加2条测试（party-member-unified-entry.test.ts）：①直接创建队友（无archetype构造→创建队友乙）断言乙拿到p2不是p1、p1空壳槽位三个持有者都在（session.get("p1")/sanityEngines.has("p1")/world.getPlayerIds()含p1）、乙八项齐全（复用assertEightThings）；②随后创建角色甲落在p1、乙不被覆盖，p1/p2八项都齐。变异检验：把pid分配改回this.party.size+1，2条新测试精确变红（既有19条仍全绿——它们每条都先跑创建角色填了party，故pid仍是p2/p3，正常路径编号不乱）；Copy-Item还原后回归21/21。typecheck exit 0；bun test连跑3次2174/0/129文件

只做路由、不碰AI侧：act() 第二参由角色显示名改为 pcId，web action 端点接受并转发 pcId，getState() 暴露队伍。现状——act(input, actingCharacterName?)（game-session.ts:1259）第二参存在但按角色显示名匹配（:1282-1288），命中后写 this.activePlayerId；web 路径 server.ts:451 永远 session.act(input) 不传第二参，于是 activePlayerId 在 web 上恒为 p1，多 PC 时无法以别的 PC 身份行动。按名字匹配还有两个毛病：重名 PC 取第一个（find 语义）、绕一圈才回到 pcId。改法：① 第二参直接收 pcId——actingCharacterName 零生产调用方（server.ts 不传），且无任何测试传第二参，直接换掉名字路径代价为零。② server action 端点做三层事：body 加可选 pcId 字段（缺省沿用 activePlayerId，与 kp/set-san 的 bodyString(body,"playerId")||activePlayerId 同一约定，保持既有客户端不破）；未知 pcId 由 act() 在**改动任何状态前**结构化校验（置 result.error{code:"unknown_target",targetId}，参照 setPlayerSan 的形状），server 翻成结构化 404——不抛异常、不兜底回 p1（那正是"报告了一件没发生的事"）；getState() 暴露 state.party（pcId+name+control），让"谁能行动"对客户端可见——control 只读不写，不加设置入口（L4 的事）。③ 为可测性把 action 端点核心抽成导出纯函数 runAction(session, body)（解析 body→可选pcId→act→error 映射→{status,body}），端点只管持久化/广播/附 summary；并把 server.ts 的 Bun.serve+启动块包进 if(import.meta.main)——被测试 import 取 runAction 时绝不能绑 3099 端口或扫 session 文件。边界情形：传了 pcId 但 PC 不在当前场景——本轮**允许**（自由跑团没有回合结构，getState 的 player/在场名单本来就按 activePlayerId 取）；并发缺口——act() 无锁改 this.round/activePlayerId/_turnMessages，两个客户端同时 POST 不同 pcId 会互相踩，本轮不做回合锁（那是 L3），在 act() 的 jsdoc 里写明这个已知缺口，别让下一个人以为路由做完就能多端并发。加 pc-route.test.ts（11条）：act按pcId路由行为正确（路由后 getState().player 与消息 speaker 归属都落在对应 PC、再切回能恢复、传当前活跃 pcId 本身不误报）、重名PC各自按pcId路由到本人（不走 find 取第一个）、未知pcId结构化拒绝且 activePlayerId/round 都不变（拒绝发生在任何改动前，且不折成正常叙事）、空壳p1建号前无卡不可行动、getState().party 暴露完整队伍、runAction 转发 pcId 到 act 的四条（含缺省沿用 activePlayerId、pcId 空白等价不传）。三侧覆盖：行为正确/目标行为错误对照/文本相似但不误报。变异检验两轮：① runAction 改回 session.act(input) 不传第二参，2 条 server 转发测试精确变红（9条游戏层直调 act 的仍绿）；② act() 的 unknown 校验短路（false&&），3 条未知pcId拒绝测试（含server 404那条）精确变红；两处 Copy-Item 还原后回归11/11。实测碰到的既有怪癖（与本题无关不修）：无 archetype 建号后 p1 的会话槽位 characterName 恒为兜底"调查员"（创建角色走 createPartyMember 对已存在 pcId 只 switchActive 不更新槽位名），导致无 archetype 下以 p1 行动的消息 speaker 是"调查员"而非真名——pr2 测试改用带 archetype 构造隔离。typecheck exit 0；bun test 连跑3次2185/0/130文件

五项开发·任务1：让意图解析的回落说话（当前它是哑的）。实跑30回合（analysis/sim/2026-08-28-barn-three-pc-run.md）里有6次意图判错（≈20%），但 intent.ts 的两处回落原先都是静默的：parseIntentLLM 内 JSON.parse 失败（:370-372，console.warn 整行被注释）与 parseIntent 外层 llm.chat() 抛错（:410-412，同样注释掉）。'LLM 答错了' 和 'LLM 一直在失败' 在外部完全无法区分，判错率无从归因。改法：两处都换成 log.warn("intent", ...) 带上原因（异常 message 前80字 / JSON解析失败的原文前80字）——只做可观测性，不动判定逻辑、不调 prompt、不改阈值，行为（照常回落 regex）完全不变。新增 intent-fallback-observability.test.ts（4条）：LLM 抛异常时有一条 warn 且含异常原因、结果仍是 regex 兜底值；LLM 返回非法 JSON 时有一条 warn 且含原文片段；LLM 正常返回合法 JSON 时零 warn（不刷屏正常路径）；未配置 LLM 的纯 regex 路径同样零 warn（静默回落只指 LLM 失败的那两处，不泛化到所有走 regex 的路径）。用 bun:test 的 spyOn(log, "warn") 断言调用次数与参数内容，不靠人眼看日志。变异检验：分别删掉两处 log.warn 调用，对应的两条 warn 存在性测试精确变红，其余两条（零 warn 场景）不受影响；revert 后 4/4 回归绿。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2216→2220（+4）、133→134 文件。

五项开发·任务2：模组摄取把文档小标题注册成了场景（这是那次毁局的根因）。mythos-module.ts 的 import() 有一行 `if (module.hooks) for (const h of module.hooks) if (h.condition) referencedScenes.add(h.condition)`，把每条 hook 的 condition 无条件当场景注册——hook 的 condition 只是「触发条件」（on_read_tome 类型的 hook，condition 是典籍名不是场景 id），从来就不该等同于地点。谷仓模组实测：sceneDescriptions 声明的真场景 22 个，最终 registerScene 的总数被灌到 39 个，混进去的 17 条里有「主要_npc」「结局」「可选」「艾德里安会在外围布置_3_种陷阱」这种一眼是文档小标题/章节标题抽取管线漏进来的东西。模糊移动的候选池（game-session.ts 的 tryResolveModuleScene）取 world.listScenes() 全量，于是「查看餐桌、披萨盒和啤酒罐」被判定送到「可能的敌人类」并打出兜底提示，实跑第 6 回合起整局再没回正轨。改法：判据按来源不按字符特征——白名单 = sceneDescriptions 声明 ∪ npc/item/tome/clue 的 sceneId 引用 ∪ module.exits 的 key 与 target（被出口连接的东西）。删掉 hook.condition 那行，加上 sceneDescriptions 与 exits 两个来源（原来这两者不直接进白名单，全靠与其它引用碰巧重叠才没漏注册，谷仓模组验证过零丢失，但不能靠碰巧）。hook 的 narration 仍然照常走第 6 步单独注册（是 lore，没有被一起丢掉）。新增 mythos-scene-whitelist.test.ts（6条）：谷仓模组注册场景数 39→26；13 个已知非地点一个都不在注册结果里；报亭（只靠 exits 才在白名单里，不在 sceneDescriptions 也不在 npc/item/tome/clue）等真地点一个没丢；注册结果与独立重算的白名单公式完全一致（不是巧合对上）；三个内置模组（印斯茅斯/阿卡姆/谷仓精简版）场景数与白名单公式一致，顺带验证了同一个 bug 在这三个模组里的另一处实例（on_read_tome 的 condition 是典籍名「扎多克的低语」「塞拉伊诺断章」，旧代码会误当场景，属于同一根因不是新问题）；hook 本身（registerHook 调用）不受影响，narration 没被一起丢。变异检验：把 hook.condition 那行加回去，6 条里 4 条精确变红（含谷仓 39→26 那条与白名单等价性两条）；revert 后 6/6 回归绿。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2220→2226（+6）、134→135 文件。

五项开发·任务3：小修五连（都在 game-session.ts）。3a getState().party 只有 {pcId,name,control}，实跑三个 PC 轮流行动 30 回合始终看不到任何人的 hp/san/status（state.player 只反映当前 active PC）——补上 hp/maxHp/status（取 world.getEntity(pcId)，与 player 单数字段同一份数据源）、san/maxSan（取 PartyMember.san，与 sanityEngines 同一引用），player 单数字段不动。3b tryResolveModuleScene 成功时不设 lastNarrative，响应沿用上一轮内容——实跑「周明回特里坎家」narrative 写的是特里坎家、state.scene 却仍是移动前的场景；移动成功时如实设一句「你来到了「X」。」。3c addPartyMember 调 buildCharacterForRuleset 无 try/catch，未知职业抛出后一路冒到 runAction 外层 catch 变成裸 500——实跑「创建队友 记者 林娜」（中文职业名不认，只认 journalist_coc 这类英文 id）与「创建队友 林娜 记者」（参数顺序写反）两次都中。接住异常走 { rejected } 形状（server.ts 已翻成 400）；加 resolveOccupationId 先按 id 精确匹配、查不到再按 getCoCArchetypes() 的 label 精确匹配（中文职业名从此可用）；rejected 消息把用法与参数顺序写反的提示都说清楚，不是只丢「未知职业: X」。3d game-session.ts 的「这里没什么特别的」（匹配层拒绝，玩家的措辞对不上任何未发现线索，没进检定）与 investigateCoC 检定失败的通用兜底「你没有找到有用的信息。」（investigation-engine.ts 两处 + game-session.ts 一处 bridgeBarnOfPremierClues 合成的 coc_primary.fail）读起来几乎一样，玩家分不清「没找对地方」和「找对了但骰子没过」——只改措辞不改判定，三处 fail 兜底文本统一改成「你仔细搜查了一番，但这次没能看出什么名堂。」。3e handleTalk 的 target 只 .trim() 不剥标点，自然语言输入「附近店铺，」这类尾随逗号原样进 key，回显打出「这里没有「附近店铺，」」——加 stripEdgePunctuation()（模块级函数，剥首尾中英文标点，不动中间），want 计算时套上。新增 task3-five-fixes.test.ts（16条，每条小修 2-3 条覆盖正确/红线/对照）：3a 两 PC 各自 hp/san 与 world/sanityEngines 一致、伤不串门、player 单数字段不受影响；3b 移动后 narrative 含新场景不含旧场景（红线用手动钉死的陈旧 lastNarrative 精确量「是否被覆盖」这一件事）；3c 未知职业/参数写反/文本命令路径都不抛异常且 rejected 消息含用法提示，中文职业名与已知英文 id 均正常建卡；3d 匹配不上与检定失败两种「没找到」用不同字符串（Math.random 钉死 0 或 0.999 分别逼成功/失败排除随机性）；3e 尾随逗号被剥、干净输入不受影响、名字中间的标点（「老王·二号」）不被误伤。变异检验五轮，每轮单独还原：① party 状态字段改回硬编码常量，2/3 变红；② 移除移动成功的 lastNarrative 赋值，2/2 变红；③ 去掉 addPartyMember 的 try/catch，3/5 变红；④ 三处 fail 文本挨个还原（investigation-engine.ts 两处 + game-session.ts 一处——第一轮只还原 investigation-engine.ts 未变红，定位到实际生效的是 game-session.ts 的合成路径，再单独还原该处才精确复现）；⑤ 去掉 stripEdgePunctuation 调用，1/3 变红；五轮均 Copy-Item 还原后回归绿。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2226→2242（+16）、135→136 文件。

五项开发·任务4：判据对齐生产路径。scripts/diag/diag-clue-phrasing.ts 的「a-裸动词」用例原先直接调 matchSceneClues("侦查", group)，报「歧义 10/10 全过」。但生产路径（GameSession.resolveSceneClueMatch）在此之前就短路了——said.length<2 时直接返回 { kind: "fallback" }（取候选首条，不问不猜），压根不会走到 matchSceneClues 内部；matchSceneClues 自己也有一条独立的 no-signal 早退（stripSearchVerbs 全句抠，不是前缀锚定），两层短路结构相似但归属不同（见 matchSceneClues 现有 docstring 里早就写明的区分）。诊断脚本绕过生产的入口短路直接调 matchSceneClues，命中的是 matchSceneClues 自己的 no-signal（报 ambiguous=全部候选），判据看着「歧义正确处理」在过，实际测的是生产从不会执行到的一条路——真实行为是静默挑了候选首条，判据全绿，行为却是它想禁止的那个。改法：保留短路（是有意的设计，注释写着「玩家压根没说要找什么，跟目标不存在是两回事」），把决策抽成纯函数 decideClueMatch()（新增于 src/investigation/clue-match.ts，与 matchSceneClues/splitKeys 等原语同一个文件）——入口短路 + matchSceneClues 派发一步做齐，返回 resolve/ask/deny/fallback 四态。GameSession.resolveSceneClueMatch 与诊断脚本改为共用这一份，不再各自维护一份短路正则（原来私有的 SEARCH_VERB_PREFIX_RAW 静态字段整体删除，逻辑搬进 decideClueMatch）。诊断侧：CluePhraseOutcome 新增可选字段 decisionKind，只给走完整 decideClueMatch 路径的用例（目前只有「a-裸动词」）填；judgeCluePhrase 对 ambiguous 类用例，若带 decisionKind 则按它判——resolve 才是「本该 fallback/ask 却抢答了」，fallback（设计如此）与 ask（真歧义，问清楚）都算诚实通过，不再笼统看 chosenClueId 是否为 null（没有 decisionKind 的用例走原逻辑兜底，保持向后兼容）。新增 clue-match-decision-parity.test.ts（8条）：decideClueMatch 对裸动词/空输入/空候选返回 fallback，带位置信号的输入仍与直接调 matchSceneClues 结果一致（行为不变的判据）；judgeCluePhrase 对 decisionKind=fallback/ask 判过、=resolve 判不过（红线）；端到端跑一次真实 GameSession + 谷仓模组，裸「侦查」确实静默取候选首条而不是问清楚或报没有。变异检验：删掉 decideClueMatch 里的入口短路（said.length<2 那行），8 条里 3 条精确变红（含端到端那条）；revert 后 8/8 回归绿。验收对齐：有位置信号的输入仍走 matchSceneClues 不变（scene-clue-input-match.test.ts 22 条原样全绿）；重跑 diag-clue-phrasing.ts，产物落 analysis/diag/diag-clue-phrasing.md，歧义 10/10（现在测的是生产真正走的那条路，不是巧合对上）。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2242→2250（+8）、136→137 文件。

五项开发·任务5：线索只对发现者可见 + 按玩家读历史。5a：PlayerSession.getPlayerHistory(playerName) 早就有，但 HTTP 只接 GET /api/sessions/:id/history 走 getHistory()→getActiveHistory()（恒返回当前活动玩家），没有 pcId 参数，外部永远看不到别的 PC 的历史，5b 做完也没人能验。加 ?pcId= 查询参数；未知 pcId（session.session.get(pcId) 查不到）明确报 404，不静默返回空数组——那和「这个人确实没历史」从外部长得一模一样，是本仓反复吃亏的静默失效。GameSession 新增 getPlayerHistory(pcId, limit?) 包一层 PlayerSession.getPlayerHistory + voiceKey 映射（与既有 getHistory 同款），pcId 校验留在路由层（server.ts），与 getKPState/setPlayerSan 等既有方法一样把校验放在 API 边界。5b：player-session.ts 早就完整实现了五档可见性（public/scene_restricted/discoverer_only/targeted/private），分派逻辑也在，但 web 路径的 buildActionResponse 统一 `this.session.push(m)` 不传 visibility，恒为 public——没有任何线索是发现者独享的。本轮只做 discoverer_only（scene_restricted 明确不碰：PlayerSlot.currentScene 只在 join 时设之后从不更新、setPlayerScene/getPlayersInScene 全仓零调用方、比的是活动玩家场景不是消息所属场景、两个 join 点给了不同的 startingScene，三个独立的坑，本轮不趟）。设计：AgentMessage.visible_to 与 PlayerSession.pushPerPlayer 是全仓零消费方的另一套预留机制，本轮不用（先决定用哪一套，不添第三套）；复用 PlayerSession.push(message, visibility, discoverer) 已经在用的 vocabulary——GameSession.addMessage 早就在传这两个参数，只是 turnMessages 这条路（占大多数消息量）此前从不传。VisibilityRule 类型从 session/player-session.ts 搬到 agent/types.ts（AgentMessage 需要它，留在 session 层会反向 import 成环），player-session.ts 改为 import 并 re-export，index.ts/game-session.ts 的既有 import 路径不用改。AgentMessage 加 visibility?/discoverer? 两个可选字段。resolveSceneClue 不改 msg() 的调用签名（29 处调用方共用同一个签名，且有测试按位置参数直接调 resolveSceneClue(clueType, msgFn)，改签名会破坏它们）：用 msg() 的返回值（messages.push 的新长度）定位刚推入的那条消息，原地补上 visibility: "discoverer_only" 与 discoverer: this.activePlayerId（与 investigateCoC 的 markDiscovered/isDiscoveredBy 同一个 pcId 口径）——act() 期间 msg() 背后的数组与 this._turnMessages 是同一个引用，直接调 resolveSceneClue（不经 act()，测试里那样）时 _turnMessages 为 null，补丁自然跳过，不影响既有测试。buildActionResponse 的回合出口 push 循环从 `this.session.push(m)` 改成 `this.session.push(m, m.visibility ?? "public", m.discoverer)`——没带这两个字段的消息（绝大多数）走默认参数，行为不变。已知缺口写进 resolveSceneClue 的 docstring：这只对存储的历史生效，ws-handler.ts 的 broadcastToSession 不按玩家过滤，live 广播仍然全员可见，私密只在「回看历史」这个维度成立，是 L6/L7b 的正题，本轮不碰。新增 clue-visibility-and-per-player-history.test.ts（8条）：5a pcId 路由本身工作正常（p1/p2 各自历史独立存在、不是同一份引用）、未知 pcId 时 session.get 返回 undefined（server.ts 路由层判据的前提）、不传 pcId 时行为与之前一致（active 玩家）；5b p1 掷出线索后 p1 历史有揭示正文 p2 没有、discoverer_only 消息不随「谁是活动玩家」变化而改变可见性、单人局本回合的即时响应与历史都不受影响（行为完全一致）、getKPState() 在线索私密后仍返回完整双 PC 状态、普通消息的 public 默认值不受这次改动影响。变异检验两轮：① resolveSceneClue 不再补 visibility/discoverer，2/8 变红；② buildActionResponse 的 push 循环改回不传 visibility 参数，2/8 变红（两轮红的是同一对用例，符合预期——两处任一没接上，行为都退化成「线索也是 public」）；两轮均 Copy-Item 还原后回归绿。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2250→2258（+8）、137→138 文件；全量测试连跑确认单人局既有测试全绿（此条判据本身）。

五项开发（第二轮）·任务1：意图可观测性有个盲点（上一轮规格写漏了，不是实现错）。上一轮加了两处 log.warn（LLM 抛错 / 返回非法 JSON 时上报），但 intent.ts 的 if(_llmClient){try{...}catch{...}} 结构里，_llmClient 为 null 时整块 if 都跳过，两处 warn 都摸不到——静默走 regex 时反而是最沉默的状态。实跑 30 回合 [intent] 日志零条，而「零条」同时符合「LLM 接上了且全对」与「LLM 根本没接、全程 regex」两种截然相反的状态，日志上完全一样。同类前科：世界模型门禁不能断言 loaded，因为懒加载时 false 是正常态——「静默=健康」的假设这仓库已经错过两次。改法：不动意图判定逻辑，只加一条起手声明。新增 declareIntentPath()（intent.ts，与 intentLLMConfigured 同处）：接上了（intentLLMConfigured() 为真）→ log.info 一条，明确说走 LLM；没接上 → log.warn 一条，区分两种不同原因——llmEnabled() 为假 vs llmEnabled() 为真但接缝本身未配置（Mock/占位 key），两种原因的措辞不同，日志能唯一反推是哪一种。调用点：GameSession 构造函数里，在决定要不要 setIntentLLM 那段代码之后调一次——一局一次，不是每回合都打。新增 intent-path-declaration.test.ts（5条）：LLM 已配置时恰好一条 info 零条 warn；LLM_DISABLED=true 时恰好一条 warn 零条 info 且含 llmEnabled；占位 key（llmEnabled 为真但接缝未配置）时恰好一条 warn 且措辞与「llmEnabled 为假」那种不同；两种场景的 (info条数,warn条数) 组合必须不同（唯一反推的直接判据）；act() 跑三轮不产生新的声明日志（验证「一局一次」）。变异检验：去掉 GameSession 构造函数里的 declareIntentPath() 调用，4/5 测试精确变红（外加 tsc 报未使用的 import）；revert 后 5/5 回归绿。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2258→2263（+5）、138→139 文件。

五项开发（第二轮）·任务2：NPC 整句台词重复（早就记在探针注释里，一直没修）。npc-dialogue.ts:742 与 scene-pipeline.ts 各自有一份 `revisitEncounter ?? firstEncounter`——LLM 没生成 revisitEncounter 时，再遇就逐字重复首见台词。探针 probe-dialogue-lead.ts §⑤ 实跑抓到过酒吧保镖那句连说四次。⚠ 重复引导句不是本任务目标（提交 a4fdb58 已判定不是病），本任务只管整句台词。改法：两处都不再回落到 firstEncounter，改落到程序化模板系统（buildDialogueForRel 等，本来就是 npc.llmExpanded 整体不存在时的路径）——按关系值分层、按性格特质选池子、pick() 随机取一条，不会逐字重复。scene-pipeline.ts 的调用点直接复用 generateNpcDialogue（npc-dialogue.ts），不重复实现一遍变化逻辑。判断用 `!= null` 不是真值判断：沉默型 NPC 的 revisitEncounter 可能是显式空字符串（templateRevisitEncounter 的 isSilent 分支），原 `??` 对空串不生效，真值判断会把它误判成缺失，让一个该沉默的 NPC 被程序化路径生成出台词来——这是实现过程中发现并顺带修正的一个边界，两处都改了。已知的复查发现：barn-of-premier.ts 在模块定义时就无条件跑 applyAllLlmExpanded()（模板），每个 NPC 的 llmExpanded 落地时 revisitEncounter 就已经有值（非沉默必为非空文本，沉默为空串）；再叠加更早一次提交（revisit-line-kept.test.ts 记录的合并保留修复）让 LLM 部分响应不会抹掉已有的 revisitEncounter——两者叠加后，'revisitEncounter 真正缺失（undefined）' 这个触发条件在 barn 模组 + LLM_DISABLED（纯模板）路径下已经很难复现，探针跑前跑后的聚合『整句台词重复』数字因此没有直接可见的变化（用一个临时的『局内去重』脚本核实过：唯一出现的重复是合法的、本就该逐字复用的手写/模板回访句，不是 bug 触发）。因此本任务的验证以确定性单测为准（与旁边 revisit-line-kept.test.ts 用 mock 的部分响应 LLM 客户端做单测验证是同一策略），不依赖探针的聚合指标。新增 npc-revisit-line-not-verbatim.test.ts（5条）：revisitEncounter 缺失时不与 firstEncounter 相同（红线）；连续 20 次调用同一 NPC 都不撞见逐字重复（覆盖 pick() 随机性）；revisitEncounter 存在时仍原样使用（对照，不被误伤）；首次见面不受影响；无 llmExpanded 的纯模板 NPC（含沉默判定）行为不变。变异检验：两处都改回 `?? firstEncounter`，5 条里 2 条精确变红；revert 后 5/5 回归绿，两处 Copy-Item 分别还原。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2263→2268（+5）、139→140 文件。

五项开发（第二轮）·任务3：检定失败要能被玩家读出来。问题A：线索路（resolveSceneClueMatch 的 resolve/fallback/ask/deny 四个分支）全部提前 return，够不到通用检定路 handleSkillCheck 裸检定分支的骰子播报（🎲 …d100=…→…）——同一句「侦查X」，走哪条路决定了看不看得见骰子（run1「侦查餐桌」走通用路有骰子，run2「侦查床底」走线索路无骰子）。问题B：上一轮把「匹配不上」（这里没什么特别的）与「检定失败」（你仔细搜查了一番，但这次没能看出什么名堂）改成两句不同的话，单测断言「两句话不同」通过了，但实跑报告仍判「玩家不知道是场景无物还是检定失败」——单测测的是字符串不同，实跑测的是读者分不分得清，两者不一致时以读者为准，这条算没修完。方案①+②：线索路检定失败时也播一条骰子（格式与通用路一致：🎲 ${skillDisplay}检定 d100=${roll} (目标=${skillValue}%) → 失败），骰子播报本身就是「检定结果」的明确表述，不依赖玩家记住两句话哪句代表哪种含义（比起单纯改措辞更稳健：不管命中的是哪个 fail 文案分支——通用兜底还是模组手写的 primary.fail，骰子这条播报都会出现，结构性保证可分辨，不依赖记住某句特定措辞）。investigateCoC 的返回类型加 skillId 字段（这次检定用的技能 id），resolveSceneClue 失败时用它查 SKILL_DISPLAY_NAMES 拼出骰子行，通过 msg() 推入 events（与通用路同一机制），并折进 lastNarrative（很多客户端只读这个字段，不逐条看 events，通用路的骰子只在 events 里、lastNarrative 不含，线索路这次两处都给，更稳）。只在失败（!result.success）时加这一行，成功路径的输出一个字不变——判定逻辑（成功率、目标值、线索归属）一律不动。顺带清理：investigation-engine.ts 里此前一次编辑意外把一段注释复制了两遍，这次一并删掉重复的那份。新增 clue-check-failure-visible.test.ts（5条）：线索路检定失败输出含 d100 骰子信息（🎲/失败/d100=数字）；检定成功时输出一个字不变（不多骰子行，措辞不变）；通用检定路与线索路失败两条路都能看见骰子（红线，通用路骰子在 events 不在 narrative——既有行为，不因这次改动而变）；检定失败与匹配不上两种「没找到」现在能用「是否含区分性信息（d100 或检定字样）」这个判据分辨，不再只断言字符串不同；两句话本身仍然不同（上一轮的判据是加强不是被推翻）。变异检验：去掉骰子行的生成与 msg() 调用，5 条里 2 条精确变红；revert 后 5/5 回归绿。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2268→2273（+5）、140→141 文件。

开发C·任务2：定死 requiredScenes 的 AND/OR。types.ts:449 注释「必须访问过的场景 ID 列表（AND）」与 barn-of-premier.ts 的实现 `requiredScenes.some(...)`（OR）矛盾，没有任何测试钉住过。选 AND：字面意思是「必须访问过」，且 requiredClues 已经是 AND，两个同名字段（都是 conditon 里的 requiredXxx）语义一致比各自实现方便更重要。复查了改动前后现有数据的匹配结果：全仓只有 3 处 requiredScenes 给了非空数组——两处单元素（AND/OR 对单元素数组没有区别：migo_escaped、END_NARRATIONS 的 true 条目）；唯一的双元素数组是 evaluateEpilogues 用到的 adrian_fate 条目（hospital + adrian_hospital_meeting）——但场景图里唯一指向 adrian_hospital_meeting 的连接来自 hospital（前往艾德里安的病房），isSceneVisited() 查的是从不清空的累计历史（WorldState.sceneHistory），所以能到达 adrian_hospital_meeting 就必然已经访问过 hospital——AND 与 OR 在这条真实数据上给出完全相同的结果，跑前跑后无变化，改动是安全的。evaluateEpilogues 的 hasScenes 判断从 `.some(...)` 改成 `.every(...)`，加长注释陈述理由与复查结论。新增 epilogue-required-scenes-and.test.ts（7条）：合成用例——两个必须场景都访问过才匹配、只访问其中一个不匹配（AND 与 OR 的分歧点，红线）、一个都没访问不匹配、空/未声明 requiredScenes 不受影响；真实数据——adrian_fate 在访问过两个场景时仍匹配（拓扑保证 AND/OR 结果相同）、只访问 hospital 不访问 adrian_hospital_meeting 时在 AND 语义下不匹配（红线，AND 生效的直接证据）、migo_escaped（单元素）不受切换影响。变异检验：改回 `.some(...)`，7 条里 2 条精确变红（含真实数据那条）；revert 后 7/7 回归绿。剧本杀路径不受影响：module-loop.test.ts 16 条全绿。typecheck exit 0；bun test 2278→2285（+7）、142→143 文件。

fix dev-server.ps1 caller hang: switch from Start-Process (plan A) to WMI Win32_Process.Create (plan B). Measured 2026-08-30: the previous Start-Process -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput/-Error avoided the orphan-process problem but left the caller itself blocked -- one real run showed 8m33s between server start and the first request, with the PID already alive and server-out.log already populated, first misdiagnosed as "start only starts the server, an empty-looking log is expected" when the caller had simply never returned. Root cause: -NoNewWindow shares the caller's console but does not remove the child from the caller's own Job Object; the caller waits for the whole process tree to exit, not for the console to close, so a new console changes nothing. Tried plan A first as instructed (drop -NoNewWindow): measured twice (via `bun run dev-server:start` and via a direct `powershell -File ... start` call) that the script itself returns in under a second while the calling shell tool still hangs until forcibly killed at the timeout -- confirms the Job Object theory rather than assuming it. Fell back to plan B: Win32_Process.Create runs via WmiPrvSE.exe, outside the caller's Job Object; measured the caller returning in ~2s across two independent start/stop cycles. Trade-off: Win32_Process.Create is a thin CreateProcess wrapper and does not understand shell redirection, so it has to launch through `cmd.exe /c ... > out 2> err`, making the WMI-created process the cmd.exe wrapper rather than the real bun.exe server; Start-DevServer polls (up to 5s) for the bun.exe child of that wrapper PID and stores the real server PID in .dev-server.pid so status/stop keep acting on the actual listening process, and additionally records the wrapper PID in the new .gitignore'd .dev-server-wrapper.pid so Stop-DevServer can explicitly kill both instead of relying on cmd.exe self-terminating once its child dies. Verified end to end, twice: start returns promptly, server-out.log/server-err.log both get real content, GET /api/config returns 200, status reports running, stop removes both PID files and leaves zero bun.exe/cmd.exe processes and no listener on 3099; also verified the already-running guard and the stop-when-not-running path. Not a test-count change (this is an external PowerShell process script, not something bun test exercises); no new bun tests. typecheck exit 0; bun test 2455 (unchanged), 158 files unchanged; preflight 12/12.

fix pendingConfirm cross-PC leakage: it must know who asked. Measured 2026-08-30 (session lcmj2joi): round 7 p1's sentence opened a compound-move re-ask ("KP is waiting to confirm whether to move first"), round 8 p2 said something unrelated ("ask Phoebe about the bar party") and that got silently consumed as the answer to p1's question, moving nobody and dropping p1's pending question. Root cause: pendingConfirm was a single session-level field that only recorded "is something pending", never "who asked". Decided (and implemented) two different rules for the two kinds, because they are different in scope: compound-move is one PC's own action deciding whether to move first, so it should only accept that PC's answer -- replaced the single field with pendingCompoundMove: Map<pcId, {originalInput, originalIntent}>, keyed per PC so two PCs can each have their own unanswered question without clobbering each other; a different PC acting while one is open now executes its own intent normally and gets a system reminder that pcId X still has an open question, rather than being silently swallowed as an answer -- explicitly documented and accepted risk: if that PC never acts again the entry just sits there (no expiry/timeout logic added, that needs its own design decision this round doesn't make). leave is a party-wide decision (whether to end the whole investigation), so it deliberately stays PC-agnostic -- kept as a plain pendingLeaveConfirm boolean, any PC's next line can confirm or cancel it. This also reverts the previous round's unification of both kinds into one PendingConfirm field/type; that unification's stated reason ("structurally impossible for two pendings to fight") only held in a single-PC model -- with multiple PCs, a party-wide leave and a per-PC compound-move being open at once is a normal state, not something to prevent. Reproduced the reported leak with the deterministic harness (game-session-run-harness.ts) rather than trusting the sim's own table (which was internally inconsistent about which round the scene actually changed) -- 3 new scripted scenarios in game-session-run-harness.test.ts: p1 opens a compound-move question, p2 acts with an unrelated sentence (no scene name in it, to keep this test isolated from the separate over-triggering issue) and its own action executes normally with a reminder shown, p1 then answers and moves correctly; same-PC round-trip regression (opening and answering as the same p1 still works); leave confirmed by a different PC (p2) than the one who opened it still ends the session, confirming the party-wide rule. Also updated compound-move-reask.test.ts's two pendingConfirm assertions to read the new pendingCompoundMove/pendingLeaveConfirm fields (behavior unchanged, single-PC case). Mutation check: made the compound-move consumption pick any pending value instead of the one keyed by the acting pcId, the cross-PC scenario went red (scene incorrectly moved from the unrelated PC's line) while the other 8 tests in the file stayed green; Copy-Item restored. Noted but out of scope: act() pushes the player's own action message twice in the compound-move-trigger path (pre-existing, confirmed via git diff against HEAD before this change, not introduced here). typecheck exit 0; bun test 2455->2458 (+3), 158 files unchanged; preflight 12/12.

fix two clue-match bugs that were the direct cause of a 7-round sim abort (analysis/sim/2026-08-31-barn-action-anchor-abort.md): three searches in a row denied without a single dice roll. Bug 1: SEARCH_VERB/SEARCH_VERB_ANY were missing "翻查" -- round 7's real sentence ("陆川仔细翻查餐桌下面...") failed the adjacency check purely because that verb wasn't in the list, even though "翻找"/"翻阅" (close synonyms) already were. Added "翻查" plus a small curated set of same-register synonyms (翻看/扒开/掀开/摸索/找找/瞧瞧) with an explicit note on why the list stays bounded (no more additions without real sim evidence). Bug 2: uniqueAbbrevs() (move-util.ts) is designed for move matching, where Chinese place names have a 2+ char head noun at the end ("维森酒吧"->"酒吧"); reused as-is for clue matching, its shortest-unique-substring algorithm ate the shared verb prefix before finding a boundary ("侦查卫生间"->"侦查卫") and, worse, sliced straight through the indivisible two-character word "卫生" to produce the meaningless suffix "生间" (round 6's real sentence used a different verb than the description, "检查" vs "侦查", so exact-substring matching never even got a chance and fell through to this broken abbreviation). Did not touch move-util.ts's uniqueAbbrevs itself (regression redline: it's shared with move matching) -- instead strip search verbs from the candidate keys/rivals before calling it, plus a small addition to also register the whole stripped noun as its own candidate when unique on its own (uniqueAbbrevs' truncation loop requires strictly-shorter lengths, so an already-exactly-2-char stripped noun like "餐桌" would otherwise never get a candidate at all). This surfaced a second-order regression caught by an existing test ("侦查卫生间已经搜过了" incorrectly matched clue_drugs): the negation/completed-context window in isRejectedMention looks a fixed 8 characters after the matched key's own end, and a truncated abbreviation ("卫生", missing its trailing "间") shifts that window just enough to miss "已经搜过了". Fixed by checking negation against the full stripped noun ("卫生间") instead of the truncated abbreviation whenever that full noun is literally present in the input, falling back to the abbreviation's own position otherwise (round 7's "餐桌" case, whose source phrase never appears verbatim, is unaffected). Added clue-match-verb-and-abbrev-fix.test.ts (12 tests) using the sim report's exact round-6/round-7 sentences plus targeted unit tests for each bug and the negation regression. Ran both diag scripts before and after as required: diag-phrasing.ts (move side, untouched code path) 800/800 hit / 144/144 negative / 234/234 ambiguous, byte-identical before and after -- confirms no move-side regression, not just by reasoning about which file was touched. diag-clue-phrasing.ts (clue side) 104/120 hit / 25/25 negative / 10/10 ambiguous, also unchanged before and after -- the fixed cases (different verb than description, exactly-2-char post-strip noun) aren't represented in that script's synthetic case generation, so the real fix is evidenced by the new targeted tests, not by a hit-rate delta; recorded here rather than silently assumed. Mutation checks: reverted the SEARCH_VERB verb list, all 7 new-verb tests plus the round-7 real-sentence test went red (round-6/bug-2 tests stayed green); reverted the strip-before-uniqueAbbrevs call, the round-6 real-sentence test plus both bug-2 unit tests went red (round-7/bug-1 tests stayed green); both reverted with Copy-Item. typecheck exit 0; bun test 2476->2488 (+12), 160->161 files; preflight 12/12.

narrow clue-match deny (scheme B): only deny when the player clearly points at something absent, not whenever wording just fails to line up. Previously decideClueMatch() denied any time the player gave "specific" content that matched nothing, including content that was really just filler. Concretely: GameSession.getSuggestions()'s own action-anchor suggestion "仔细搜查这里" stripped down to "仔细这里" (4 chars, clears the >=2 no-signal threshold) even though "这里" doesn't name any location -- the anchor recommended an action guaranteed to deny. Added stripLocationFillers() (这里/那里/那儿/四周/周围, exported alongside stripSearchVerbs) and applied it wherever content-signal length is judged: matchSceneClues()'s internal no-signal check, and decideClueMatch()'s entry-level short-circuit. Also widened SEARCH_VERB_ANY (the full-string strip used for that same signal computation, and for task 1's uniqueAbbrevs preprocessing) with a small set of manner adverbs that commonly precede search verbs in this data (仔细/认真/再次/好好) -- deliberately not added to the anchored SEARCH_VERB used by hasSearchIntent, since an adverb alone isn't a search action and there's no evidence it should count as one for that check. Widened ENTRY_VERB_PREFIX to accept one optional adverb before the verb, still anchored and still only one verb -- "仔细搜查这里" now short-circuits to fallback at the entry level (same treatment as a bare verb, one click still gets one real result) instead of falling through to matchSceneClues and coming back "ask" (a clarifying question defeats a one-click action-anchor button) or "deny". Verified explicitly that a genuinely-absent object ("拖车房搜「保险柜」", not mentioned by any clue in that scene) still denies -- the narrowing only removes filler-only false positives, it doesn't turn deny into a rare/soft outcome. Added clue-match-deny-narrowing.test.ts (9 tests): stripLocationFillers unit coverage, the fallback outcome for the action-anchor's own suggestion text at both the decideClueMatch and matchSceneClues layers plus an end-to-end GameSession round trip proving a real check result (not the old "这里没什么特别的" deny line), the 保险柜 preservation case at both the decision and end-to-end layers, and a regression pair (bare 侦查 still fallback, a real location hint still resolves). Side effect noticed while re-running the required before/after diag pass: diag-clue-phrasing.ts's hit rate moved from 104/120 (86.7%) to 106/120 (88.3%) -- the manner-adverb stripping also cleans up some of the synthetic abbreviation cases from task 1's fix, recorded honestly rather than claimed as an explicit goal of this task. diag-phrasing.ts (move side, untouched code path) stayed at 800/800 hit / 144/144 negative / 234/234 ambiguous. add directional degrade hints on early-game skill-check failures, instead of blocking investigation. Design principle (decided): other than repeated hard failures, don't block investigation early on. resolveSceneClue()'s generic "you searched but found nothing" failure line is now replaced, only during isEarlyGame(), with a hint extracted from that clue's own findMethods description (extractLocationHint(), reusing splitKeys/stripSearchVerbs/stripLocationFillers from tasks 1-2, picking the shortest 2-6 char candidate so a direction like "卫生间" wins over a long free-text segment) -- direction only, never the clue's name or content. Division of labor vs the action anchor from a previous round: the anchor is free and never points at a location, one failed roll earns a direction. Added ModuleSupport.earlyGameEndSceneId (same family as hubSceneId/finaleSceneId); BARN_SUPPORT sets it to adrian_farm -- the module text says the red-painted barn becomes visible on reaching the farm entrance (S.FARM's own description), a real narrative turning point, and barn_building itself is already inside the finale range so it can't be the marker. isSceneVisited() already bridges ASCII/runtime scene ids for premiers_barn from an earlier round, so the ASCII id can be passed straight in. For modules without a declared ModuleSupport marker, added a ratio rule: discovered / matchTexts-bearing clue count < 1/3, with a fallback to counting all module-scoped clues when none have matchTexts. Added InvestigationEngine.listModuleClueIds(): scoped by unioning getSceneClues() over the world's actually-registered scenes rather than listing the clueTypes map directly, because that map is global and includes investigation.yaml's demo clue types (scene: "地下室"/"书房"/"客厅") that don't belong to any loaded module and would silently corrupt the denominator (measured: without this scoping, ARKHAM's 3 real clues got diluted to a denominator of 8). Verified the 1/3 branch honestly: ARKHAM (arkham_library) and INNSMOUTH (innsmouth_shadow) both have only 3 clues, none with matchTexts, so the fallback-to-all-clues path applies and 1/3 rounds down to 1 -- finding a single clue ends "early game" immediately for those two modules. This is not a bug in the branch itself; those modules have no ending data at all (see MODULE_ENDING_SUPPORT's own comment) and are thin content, a todo-19 downstream fact -- recorded as todo-42 rather than pretended to work meaningfully. Added early-game-hint.test.ts (9 tests): extractLocationHint unit coverage (real clue_drugs/clue_card/clue_pistol descriptions, and the null case for content that doesn't reduce to a clean 2-6 char segment), the adrian_farm boundary (before/after, end to end through a real failed check, and a same-scene regression proving the generic failure line returns once game.isEarlyGame() is false), a success-path regression (untouched), and the ARKHAM ratio case (fresh load early, false after the first discovery). bring the play/clue-check.ts failback ladder into GameSession's free-roam clue path (N=2). The scripted path has had a fail-count-driven rescue ladder since commit 1b9ff7f; GameSession's investigateCoC only had DifficultyProfile and nothing else -- a third instance of "two runtimes each hold half" (world state and endings were the first two, todo-03). Decided ladder for core clues: 2 consecutive fails -> an idea (灵感/INT) roll instead of the clue's own skill; fail that too -> a "no side effect" retry of the original skill; fail that too -> grant the clue directly with no roll. "No side effect" defined precisely: doesn't burn luck (investigateCoC never has, no luckSpend param at all), isn't counted as pushed (CoCEngine.skillCheck's pushed stays false, same as the pre-existing default), but time still advances normally -- no special-cased advanceTime skip. Storage: added a clue_fail_counts table to WorldStateManager (incrementClueFail/getClueFailCount/resetClueFails, same names/semantics as src/world/state.ts's WorldState so both paths reason about the mechanic identically) instead of opening a new in-memory Map on GameSession, per todo-03's direction (clue discovery and scene visits moved there last round). Extended InvestigationEngine.investigateCoC() with an optional overrideSkill parameter ({id, value, pushed?, forceSuccess?}) so the idea-roll and direct-grant steps reuse the exact same revelation-selection/SAN-cost/markDiscovered logic as a normal check instead of duplicating it three times in game-session.ts; forceSuccess skips CoCEngine.skillCheck entirely (roll stays 0, distinguishable from a real 1-100 roll) and takes the regular-success text/SAN tier. Added isCoreClue() and exposed pushed/luckSpent on the return value for direct assertions. Fixed a real pre-existing dead branch as a side effect: "灵感" (Idea) was never in coc-character.ts's ATTRIBUTE_NAME_MAP, so resolveCheckValue(pc, "灵感") always returned 0 -- traps.ts:78's "military background can use 灵感 instead" alternative-skill path for trap detection had never actually worked. Added the alias (灵感 -> intelligence, matching CoC 7e where INT is already the Idea roll target on its 15-90 scale, no ×5 needed) and verified module-loop.test.ts/trap-mechanics.test.ts stay green. Added clue-failback-ladder.test.ts (9 tests): each ladder stage verified by its dice-line skill label (spot_hidden/spot_hidden/idea/spot_hidden/no roll at all), the three no-side-effect assertions (luck unchanged across the whole ladder, a direct investigateCoC call at the retry stage returning pushed:false and luckSpent:0, and game time/round count advancing normally through all five attempts), and a non-core-clue regression confirming fail counts don't accumulate outside the ladder's scope. module-loop.test.ts (16/16) and trap-mechanics.test.ts confirmed unaffected. make clue-match respond to "you named an object here", not "did you use an investigation verb" (scheme c). analysis/sim/2026-08-31-barn-completion-attempt.md: a real 25-round playthrough reached the control room and got permanently stuck -- clue_control_supplies ("the fridge and the cabinet", a Good-End requirement) never matched "打开冰箱与储物柜" because "打开" isn't in any verb table, so intent.ts classified it as unknown, act() fell through to LLM narration, and the LLM invented "it's empty inside" -- an irreversible denial of module fact (the player won't re-open a container the game just told them is empty). Even for inputs that DID classify as skill_check ("检查冰箱"), clue-match.ts's own hasSearchIntent gate required the object's abbreviation to sit immediately after one of a fixed set of investigation verbs; "打开"/"看看"/"拉"/"翻" weren't in that set either, and the previous round already tried widening it once (翻查/翻看/扒开/掀开/摸索/找找/瞧瞧) and it still wasn't enough -- confirming the verb-table approach can't be filled by adding more words. Deleted hasSearchIntent and the anchored SEARCH_VERB constant entirely rather than widening them again. matchSceneClues's three hit branches (exact key, reverse-containment, abbreviation) now all gate on a single isExcludedMention() check instead: isRejectedMention (already existed, negation/already-done) plus a new isManipulationMention (a small, task-justified list -- 推开/挡住/藏到/藏在/躲到/躲在/靠着/搬开/搬走 -- for "treating the object as a prop or obstacle, not searching it", covering the task's two explicit edge cases "我把冰箱推开挡住门"/"藏到储物柜后面"). Tried a third check ("bare subject followed by a whole descriptive clause", meant to also exclude incidental mentions like "卫生间坏了") but reverted it after measuring: it broke diag-clue-phrasing.ts's negative-case suite from 25/25 to 0/25, because the synthetic "X已经搜过了，Y还没看过" pattern has the identical bare-subject-then-predicate shape as the state-description sentences it was meant to exclude, and telling them apart needs understanding whether the predicate means "not done yet" (keep) vs "just describing" (drop) -- the same open-ended-word-list failure mode task 1 was explicitly trying to get away from, just moved to a different vocabulary; recorded the attempt and the reason for abandoning it directly in the isExcludedMention comment. Still had to wire this into production separately from the matcher fix: since "打开冰箱与储物柜" classifies as intent.action=="unknown" at the outer parser, handleSkillCheck (only reachable via action=="skill_check") never runs at all no matter how good clue-match.ts gets. Extracted matchCurrentSceneClue()/applyClueDecision() out of handleSkillCheck's clue branch (was inlined) so both it and a new gate in act() share the same "look up undiscovered scene clues, ask decideClueMatch" logic instead of two copies; the two callers deliberately differ on how they handle a "fallback" decision (no real object signal) -- handleSkillCheck still defaults to the first candidate (an explicit skill_check already declared "I want to investigate"), the new unknown-action gate leaves it alone entirely so unrelated unknown sentences ("陆川觉得很紧张") aren't hijacked into a forced clue reveal. Added clue-object-name-gate.test.ts (16 tests) using the sim report's real sentences: the four unverbed real inputs all reach a real decision (not deny/fallback), 打开冰箱与储物柜/打开冰箱/看看储物柜 resolve to clue_control_supplies, 拉一下拉杆 resolves to clue_control_lever, the long "陆川去翻中控室的储物柜" reaches a real decision (documented as "ask" rather than "resolve" -- its abbreviation "中控" happens to also be a substring of the scene's own name "中控室", a real but narrow edge case, and "ask" still satisfies "reaches clue resolution" since it's a legitimate clarifying question, not a silent failure), the two manipulation sentences still deny, the trailer's "保险柜" (an object no clue mentions) still denies (scheme B preserved), 检查冰箱/搜查储物柜 are unchanged, and three end-to-end GameSession round trips confirm clue_control_supplies/clue_control_lever actually get discovered with no "empty" narration, an unrelated unknown sentence discovers nothing, and the skill_check path is unaffected. Ran both diag scripts before and after: diag-phrasing.ts (move side, untouched code) stayed byte-identical at 800/800 hit / 144/144 negative / 234/234 ambiguous; diag-clue-phrasing.ts's negative suite is back to 25/25 (the number that motivated dropping isBareSubjectMention) and its hit rate is unchanged from last round's baseline at 106/120 (88.3%) -- the object-name gate mostly helps unverbed real sentences, which aren't represented in that script's synthetic case generation. widen the object-name gate to look (task 1 of the gate-widening round). Added a second, narrower gate for look: only fires after handleIntent's own case "look" (which tries tryResolveModuleScene first) returns unhandled, so a real scene name ("看看维森酒吧") still wins via movement before clue-matching ever gets a turn. Also deliberately excludes decision.kind==="deny" for the look gate specifically (allowDeny:false, vs allowDeny:true for the unknown gate) -- unlike unknown (where the engine genuinely doesn't know player intent, so an honest "nothing here" beats LLM hallucination), look already has a clear default (scene description/narration), and a generic "环顾四周" reduces to a clue-match miss under decideClueMatch's own scoring (enough non-filler characters to skip the no-signal shortcut), which would incorrectly print "这里没什么特别的" for an action that never named anything. Covers: both container inputs end-to-end discovering clue_control_supplies when forced to look; a real scene name ("看看维森酒吧") still moves instead of being pulled into clue matching; "环顾四周" forced to look with no target doesn't get the deny message; unrelated narration ("陆川觉得很紧张") discovers nothing; and the three previous round's unknown inputs (打开冰箱/拉一下拉杆/清点冰箱里的东西) remain unaffected. add per-turn intent-path observability only: GameSession.traceIntent() emits log.debug under one grep-friendly scope (intent-trace), with round/pc on every line. It records parsed input/action/target/skill, confirmation gate route, compound re-execution route, object-gate entry/result, handler name/start/handled, investigative clue decision kind/clueId/candidate count, and the final LLM narration fallback reason. It deliberately never logs narrative body; input is retained for reproduction. Debug is default-silent (log.ts threshold defaults to info), so player-visible behavior and normal log output stay unchanged. Comments document that debug/info go stdout/server-out.log while warn fallbacks go stderr/server-err.log. fix dev-server.ps1 WMI environment forwarding. Win32_Process.Create inherits WmiPrvSE.exe's environment, not the caller PowerShell environment: existing WORLD_MODEL_PATH/CTHULHU_MODEL_PATH assignment was inert, and LOG_LEVEL was never forwarded, so intent-trace could not be enabled through the documented launcher. Kept solution B (WMI detachment / no caller Job Object hang) and PID cleanup untouched; built a bounded cmd.exe prefix from an explicit whitelist only: LOG_LEVEL, WORLD_MODEL_PATH, CTHULHU_MODEL_PATH, PORT. Each populated value becomes cmd's standard set "X=Y" form chained directly with && (no space before &&, because cmd would store it as a trailing value space), before bun src/api/server.ts redirection. Escapes caller-provided double quotes with ^. Corrected the preceding world-model comment: explicit paths are only genuinely more robust now that the cmd child receives them; before this change that claim was backwards. Added 3 static script-shape tests for whitelist/process-env lookup, exact no-space && prefix plus wrapper insertion, and corrected WMI inheritance comment; mutation removing envPrefix made wrapper test red, restored. Primary live acceptance ran 3 WMI start/stop cycles: (1) caller LOG_LEVEL=debug, create session/action, server-out.log contained intent-trace; (2) no LOG_LEVEL, same action, server-out.log contained no trace; (3) caller WORLD_MODEL_PATH=C:aitrpgdefinitely-missing-model.jsonl, GET /api/config returned that exact path and exists=false (previous behavior would have remained true). Every stop removed both PID files and returned promptly; every start returned promptly. typecheck 0; bun test 2569->2572 (+3, 170->171); preflight 12/12.

bedroom clue fix, phase 1 of the intent-trace-driven bedroom investigation round. analysis/sim/2026-08-31-barn-bedroom-intent-trace.md pinned the root cause with a debug trace, not a guess: two natural bedroom-search sentences both went through skill_check with zero LLM fallback, and both got denied by clue-match.ts, because clue_bedroom_diary and clue_bedroom_old_doc have heavily overlapping matchTexts (uniqueAbbrevs can't find a short unique fragment, forcing an unspeakable fragment like "diary-with"). The module data already declares the dependency (diary.unlocks = [old_doc]), but that field was only ever consumed by world/state.ts's scripted-module path (auto-chain on discovery) -- GameSession/InvestigationEngine never read it, so the bridge layer silently dropped it. Task 1: added ClueDef.unlocks (storage + bridge passthrough) and InvestigationEngine.isLockedByUndiscoveredPrerequisite(), which scans all clue defs for any that list a given id under unlocks and are still undiscovered -- reused the prerequisite relationship, not state.ts's auto-chain behavior (explicitly not done: chaining would let anyone touching the diary auto-read Mi-Go contact lore and erase the Good/True End split, plus skip an owed SAN cost). Added an alias-contains tier to scene-resolve.ts (checked before the existing real-name-contains tier, only for aliases that differ from a scene's own name, so it's a no-op for every other scene that currently only aliases itself), registered "维修室" as an extra alias for maintenance_room in game-session.ts's module-load alias population, and added a narrow self-match guard in tryResolveModuleScene: a heuristic-tier (alias-contains/contains/bigram) resolution that equals the current scene is treated as a miss rather than a fake no-op success, restricted to fuzzy tiers so an explicit exact restatement of the current scene name still works. Also unified the wording in barn-of-premier.ts's diary clue description/revelation and the sewer scene's connection condition from "维修室" to "维修间" (left the room's own MAINTENANCE_ROOM narrative text alone -- it quotes an in-world rusty sign reading "维修室", PDF-sourced content, out of scope for this clue-gate-only phase). Added bedroom-clue-prerequisite-gate.test.ts (13 tests: unit-level isLockedByUndiscoveredPrerequisite, decideClueMatch before/after removing old_doc from candidates proving the root cause, e2e resolve of both report sentences, no-auto-chain regression, post-diary re-eligibility of old_doc, and the maintenance-room alias/self-match e2e cases) and 4 new tests in scene-resolve.test.ts for the alias-contains tier itself.
